findings.evidence: `ContinuousOn.comp_continuous` in mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousOn.lean:525 concludes `Continuous (g ∘ f)`, whereas the goal is stated as `Continuous fun x ↦ f (max x 0)`.
findings.fix: Replace with an explicit rewrite, e.g. `simpa [Function.comp_def] using hf.comp_continuous (continuous_id'.max continuous_const) ...`, or use `fun_prop`.
findings.issue: `convert ... using 1; ext x; rfl` (also at lines 99-102) discharges `(fun x ↦ f (max x 0)) = f ∘ (fun x ↦ max x 0)` — and `max (id x) 0 = max x 0` from `continuous_id.max` — by accidental definitional unfolding of `Function.comp`/`id`, which is exactly the fragile defeq reliance the proof should name explicitly.

summary: The mathematics is fine but the two main proofs duplicate an identical continuity argument verbatim and both close it with a convert-on-defeq; one proof also carries a change step whose justifying comment does not match what the tactic does.
